notes: SEQN is the unique respondent identifier in NHANES, mapped to person_source_value to retain the original identifier.

Dietary day one sample weight is a survey weight variable. It can be stored as an observation with a custom concept for survey weights, or used in analysis but not directly mapped to a standard clinical concept.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey weight variable. Similar to WTDRD1, stored as an observation value.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating the status of the dietary recall. It can be mapped to an observation with a custom concept representing the status categories.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer. It can be stored as an observation string value, as it does not represent a clinical concept.
Breast-fed infant indicator is a binary variable. It can be mapped to an observation using a custom concept for breast-feeding status, or potentially linked to a standard concept if available.
Number of days of intake is an ordinal count. It can be stored as a numeric observation value.
Number of days between intake and household interview is a continuous variable. It can be stored as a numeric observation value.
Intake day of the week is a categorical variable. It can be mapped to an observation using a custom concept for days of the week.
Language used mostly by respondent is a categorical variable. It can be mapped to an observation with a custom concept for languages.
Main respondent for this interview is a categorical variable indicating who responded. It can be mapped to an observation with a custom concept for respondent type.
Helped in responding for this interview is a categorical variable. It can be mapped to an observation with a custom concept for assistance status.
Number of foods/beverages reported is a continuous count. It can be stored as a numeric observation value.
Salt used at table yesterday is a binary variable. It can be mapped to an observation using a custom concept for salt use, or potentially a standard concept for dietary salt use.
Type of salt used yesterday is a categorical variable. It can be mapped to an observation with a custom concept for salt types.
